name: Avena Archive
description: An editorial page with offset horizontal grain-window portraits, a fine panicle drawing in the margin and a generous writing column.

name: Kilnlight
description: A typography-first composition with a curved mill-end header, a ruled side band and a quiet rectangular reading surface.

name: Husk & Honey
description: A compact portrait sits in a notched colour frame beside the title, above a broad writing area with a woven hem.

name: Oatmilk Press
description: A folded carton-inspired frame with an angular cap, two photographic windows and a wide member-colour label band.

name: Fieldwake
description: An airy open page with a slanting panicle above the title, a suspended name bar and three fine harvest lines.

name: Groatline
description: A notchless smartphone with a square contact portrait, short grain-shaped speaker slots and an inset conversation screen.

name: Rolled Signal
description: A rollable electronic screen held between two cylindrical end bars, with wide incoming messages and a narrow side control.

name: Kernel OS
description: A compact handheld terminal with twin small contact windows, a recessed screen and a row of oval navigation keys.

name: Overnight Sync
description: A bedside message clock with a panoramic contact image, an oversized time display, soft notification cards and a low speaker grille.

name: Harvest Pocket
description: A slim e-ink handset with a vertical stylus channel, an offset contact heading and crisp rectangular message cards.

name: Floret
description: A compact oval-ended note with a tiny falling grain motif, a centred name and a delicate italic heading.

name: Groat
description: A miniature two-column reply with a squared portrait tile and a member-colour border that turns around its lower edge.

name: Chafflet
description: A small folded-paper reply with three stitched colour bars and an angled upper corner.

name: Twin Flakes
description: A short reply above two tilted clipped portrait tiles, finished with a small name line between the images and heading.

name: Milkdrop
description: A tiny asymmetric note with a tapered corner, a narrow side title and three rolled-grain marks.
